candidate_radius_schedule: Every method uses 5 paired directions at the full radius and 5 paired directions at half radius.
budget_interpretation: Logical costs describe a standalone GAS estimate at each prefix. Nested execution reuses every smaller prefix inside the largest design.
search_interpretation: Search curves condition on the estimated directions and hold the 20-candidate search budget fixed; GAS direction-estimation calls are reported separately and are not included in that candidate budget.
adaptive_search_dimension: Each CRN-GAS search uses its estimate's own 90%-energy dimension. The search curve therefore evaluates the complete estimated-basis procedure, not orientation alone.
independent_protocol_interpretation: This is a deliberately naive independent-seed finite-difference control. Near-boundary differences can divide independent training noise by a small coordinate displacement, producing heavy-tailed errors.
reference_interpretation: A fixed higher-budget CRN estimate used as a pathwise benchmark, not ground truth.
direction_curve_statistical_unit: independent nested-design repeat conditional on one fixed synthetic data problem
search_statistical_unit: independent direction-estimation and candidate-search repeat conditional on one fixed synthetic data problem
